title: Money was found
notes: 🔴 Legally sensitive. Every clip carries check '11a legal read'. Nothing here says or shows fraud, charges, conviction, £148m, 'Tory peer', or that the Bank's money or these contracts paid for the yacht (facts.md §18, storyboard guardrails 1-7).

No photograph of Baroness Mone. Headlines used are headline-only crops, all BBC except Boat International: VIP lane (12 Jan 2022), high court ordered to pay £122m (1 Oct 2025), admits she stands to benefit from £60m (17 Dec 2023), and the Lady M auction (18 Jul 2024). Not used: LBC, Good Law Project, the liquidators' claims (thebusinessdesk, BBC 24 Jun 2026), ITV ('Tory peer'), BBC 10 Dec 2023 ('Tory peer'), BBC 19 Dec 2025 (£148m), the Covid inquiry £10bn headline.

The VIP-lane headline (11a-05) illustrates the lane, not this company: the 2022 ruling concerned two other firms (PestFix, Ayanda), and the crop's own standfirst says 'to two companies'. The legal read should confirm the pairing.

Changed from the plan: the plan's gown photograph (US Embassy, Dhaka shipment, identifiable people incl. Ambassador Earl Miller) is NOT used under 'The gowns are rejected'. Laid under that line it could imply that real shipment or those people were rejected. The court's own conclusion, para 330 ('Medpro was in breach of contract in that the Gowns did not comply…'), is used instead.

The plan's 'scene 11a' quote card QUOTE-MONE-2020 ('…no financial benefit whatsoever…', attributed to emails reported by the Guardian) goes under P8.13; the Guardian itself was not fetched (facts.md §18), so the attribution needs the legal read and a source check.

Yacht: placeholder PH-11A-Y with LABEL-ILLUSTRATION (Kai has not approved a plate; never a photograph of any 'Lady M'). The COLUMN-11A card says '2021 · YACHT': the purchase date is unverified (facts.md §18 ❓). If it cannot be attributed at record time, drop P8.16 and the column's middle line together.

The reprise 'In the 1940s, the people with the most paid the most' uses Know Your Ally: Britain's 'HIGH INCOME TAX 97½%' shot (a society wedding, top hats). The caption is the American film's, not an official UK rate (facts.md §7), so the shot carries LABEL-AMERICAN-FILM-1944.
Endings: VERB-2020-PLANT on the wages line, VERB-2020-SHAKE on the priority-lane line (storyboard), and a SHAKE reprise under the last line, then 5 s of black as the DIP into movement 5.
Credits on screen by paper and date for every headline (the crops show masthead and date; a typed credit line may still be wanted).
